title: Aggregating many estimators using estimated weights
abstract: arXiv:2609.19415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consider an increasing number of consistent estimators to be averaged when only estimated weights are available. The underlying parameter of interest can be identical across estimators (homogeneity) or not (heterogeneity). The contribution of the paper is threefold. First, it is shown that the interaction of the estimated weights with the estimators can generate specific bias terms. This constrains the number of estimators that can be aggregated when weight estimation is ignored in inference. Second, the paper proposes estimated adaptive weights, which allow for standard Gaussian inference in a uniform manner and are asymptotically optimal both under homogeneity and heterogeneity. Third, conditions ensuring the validity of the Cochran (1937) Q test of homogeneity with estimated variance are given.

translated_title: 使用估计权重聚合众多估计量
translated_abstract: 考虑在仅有估计权重可用的情况下，对数量不断增加的一致估计量进行平均。感兴趣的潜在参数在不同估计量之间可以相同（同质性）或不同（异质性）。本文的贡献有三个方面。首先，研究表明估计权重与估计量之间的相互作用会产生特定的偏差项。这在推断中忽略权重估计时限制了可聚合的估计量数量。其次，本文提出了估计的自适应权重，该方法允许以统一的方式进行标准高斯推断，并且在同质性和异质性情形下均具有渐近最优性。第三，给出了确保使用估计方差的Cochran (1937) Q同质性检验有效性的条件。
tldr: 本文提出估计的自适应权重方法用于聚合多个估计量，揭示了估计权重与估计量相互作用产生的偏差项对可聚合估计量数量的限制，该方法在同质性和异质性情形下均能实现统一的标准高斯推断并具有渐近最优性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes estimated adaptive weights for aggregating many estimators, shows that interactions between estimated weights and estimators create bias terms limiting the number of aggregable estimators, and achieves uniform standard Gaussian inference with asymptotic optimality under both homogeneity and heterogeneity.
